text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand hasn't shown up for training,
even though it's past our scheduled time.
Just as I start to worry—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Well... um...
I was watching some fishing videos, and...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Secret Tips for Choosing Lures",
"The Ultimate Fishing Bait Showdown!"...
Recommended videos kept popping up one after another...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away... and before I knew it...
...I'm so very sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed truly remorseful,
so I decided to let the matter drop.
